profile.headline: Senior Director / VP Engineering | Enterprise Platforms | Cloud Transformation | Revenue Systems | Engineering Strategy | Organizational Leadership
profile.summary:
I am a technology leader with more than 20 years of experience building and transforming enterprise software platforms that support critical business operations and billions of dollars in annual revenue.
Throughout my career at LexisNexis, I have progressed from software engineer to Director of Software Engineering, leading modernization initiatives, cloud transformations, enterprise billing platforms, and acquisition integrations. My experience spans software engineering leadership, enterprise architecture, financial systems, Agile delivery, and organizational development.
Highlights of my experience include:
• Leading technology initiatives supporting more than $2B in annual revenue
• Driving migration of 200+ applications and services to Azure cloud platforms
• Leading billing and revenue platform modernization initiatives
• Delivering operational efficiencies exceeding $80M annually
• Supporting integration of more than 30 acquisitions
• Building and mentoring engineering leaders and high-performing teams
I am passionate about aligning technology investments with business outcomes, developing future leaders, and helping organizations modernize complex enterprise environments.
Areas of focus include Engineering Leadership, Enterprise Platforms, Cloud Transformation, Revenue Systems, M&A Integration, Organizational Development, and Technology Strategy.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer, Team Lead
positions.description: Design, technical lead and co-architecture of the billing centralization project of the company. On March 2013 finished migration of $1 billion dollar yearly billing revenue system from the mainframe to relational DB(mySQL) and object oriented language (C#). Tasks includes database design,application design& implementation, new scheme of authorization and authentication, along with coordination of a small team of developers. Infrastructure contained of multi-tier application design working as a lead in the web-services design and implementation (C#), working jointly with front end developers (PHP). This project has served as the migration platform for other products in the company which had their own back-office system and with the integration in this centralize back-office, cost reduction has been achieved as well as being able to re-use everything the infrastructure provides by just adding the new product with just some small changes. Databases uses are mySQL, SQL Server and Sybase. Currently working as technology lead for the billing department of back-office department exploring and proposing initiatives to enhance current and recently migrated processes, including internationalization of our billing platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Analysis and development of projects based in .NET technology, mostly developed in C# language to support the back-office operations, including admins, end of the month/billing process. Databases uses are mySQL, SQL Server and Sybase

positions.title: Software developer
positions.description: Analysis and development of projects based in .NET technology, mostly developed in ASP.NET technology based in C# language, using NMock to setup the test scenarios. The development made was to create the website Nomaders, which is a travel booking system(http://nomaders.com/). Development was made mostly in the business component area and some small development in the UI.

positions.title: R&D Application Software engineer
positions.description: Analysis and development of modules for a DMS (Dealer Management System) developed in Cobol language interacting with a SQL Server 2000 database for the sales area of the DMS.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Analysis and development of systems using .NET (mainly Visual Basic .NET, ASP.NET and C#) ,report designing using Crystal Reports, interacting with SQL Server 2000 databases. Complementary network administration of the company, using backup applications (like Veritas), database maintenance using SQL Server, e-mail server management as well as firewalls using the ISA servers program for four months.

positions.title: System analyst (Full-time intern-ship)
positions.description: Maintenance and creation of menus for controlling the diverse instances of databases using UNIX operating system. Script programming was done using the diverse shells UNIX provide. Software development using Visual Studio, using the ASP language and a Microsoft SQL Server database.
